home.introBefore: Founded in 2023 by amplify.dev, we're the team behind Space, DayDream X, DayLight, and more — serving over 3 million users in the past year alone. With a growing Discord community of
home.introAfter: members, we build fast, privacy-first SaaS tools designed with user safety at the core. We believe in Control, Privacy, and Freedom — and we strive to create a better internet for everyone.

space.name: Space
space.description: Space is a next-gen proxy that has revolutionized the proxy scene with its incredible UI, functionality, and speeds. Space is the flagship proxy for Night Network using never before seen blob cloaking, account system, and more!

daydreamx.name: DayDream X
daydreamx.description: Your favorite browser in a browser.

linkArchive.name: Link Archive
linkArchive.description: Mass Link storage solution with filter categorization, automatic link generation, and more. themed off of Amplify's Cat.

nyxai.name: NyxAI
nyxai.description: Advanced AI with in your browser. Simple, but Powerful.

daylight.name: DayLight
daylight.description: Daylight is a simplistic proxy with smooth animations, fast speeds, custom themes, and custom extensions. In addition, Daylight has a vertical tab system in a similar style to arc.

umbra.name: Umbra
umbra.description: Umbra is a music player with custom audio visualization, cover rendering, playlist support and sharing, and more. Umbra also has fast speeds and high-quality music.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: As Umbra is music, Aurora is video. Play your videos and media with the same familiar ease from Umbra.
